content: Un'kɔɔn lɛɛ làkwikilà
Ɔ insil a Angalàtyà! Nà kàlalɔ̈? Kyekà, Yɛsu Klistɔ awà bàbɛɛrà u kulunsi bun'swɛŋ u mii a bɛ.
Mɛ alàsà mfuul mwɛy mpɛl: Nkye bɛ Dweelà làwɛl ntɔn làsyäälà bɛ un'kɔɔn lɛɛ ntɔn làwem bɛ Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà làsi bɛ làkwikilà amu la?
Abà, nkye bɛ làbà insil? Utàtwɛb bɛ làsɛmà a Dweelà, nkye ŋàbawà bɛ làkwen mukàtsü a ndür?
Nkye mbɔɔn a mpay làmɛn bɛ yàkäl yà bunàbun? Ikwo anki naa ya ikäl yà bunàbun!
Mbuur afàlapà Dweelà anà afàkyer impà uboo a bɛ, nkye nde bya afàkyer ntɔn làfàlab bɛ Un'kɔɔn lɛɛ, ntɔn làwem bɛ làsaŋ a làkwikilà?
Ntɔn Abàlam kàkäl anà làkwikilà amu Nzam, kyakin kàmɛnà nde wàbalàbal.
Làyöb abun naa: baar abye anà làkwikilà bà baan a Abàlam.

Abà sye, Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yàtɛn naa Nzam asàkyey baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn làkwikilà aba. Kyakin bàsam ba Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà kusà akà Abàlam naa: « In'sɛŋ myanswà myàsàwal nsaak amu ngye. »
Kyakin, baar abà anà làkwikilà ban'wal nsaak mbwo mwɛy anà Abàlam, aŋàlàkwikilà.
Ntɔn, asyääl a un'kɔɔn banswà bà unsà un'küül. Ntɔn bàsön naa: « Wɛy ŋakaan udi mbuur wanswà afàkɔɔn asà muküünà mukwey ndaa yanswà bàsön uboo a Un'kaan a un'kɔɔn. »
Yà ndandaa naa akà mbuur mwɛy wàbalàbal watɛy kusà a Nzam u mbwo a un'kɔɔn, ntɔn bàsɔn naa: « Mbuur a balàbal asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ntɔn làkwikilà. »
Kyekà, un'kɔɔn làbɛɛŋ latɛy anà làkwikilà, asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn naa: « Mbuur asàkwey nswɛɛŋ a un'kɔɔn awà, asàkal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ amu wa. »
Klistɔ kàfür ntɔn mukitwey unsà un'küül a un'kɔɔn, nde ŋakwo kàbulà un'küül ntɔn bi, ntɔn bàsön naa: « Wɛy ukäl aŋàküül mbuur wanswà ban'bɛɛrà kà un'te. »
Yà abun naa làsaak a Abàlam làsàtööl akà baar mpa abà Ayudà u mbwo a kab a ngway a Yɛsu Klistɔ, naa bi banswà isàwal Dweelà kàpɛ Nzam ilää u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Un'kɔɔn anà ilää
Atɔŋ, mbar bi itàtɛn unsà imbuur: isàkal naa kyän kàsön mbuur là u mbwo a la, akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mulwom itàkal mukwɛy undiir uboo a la.
Abun, ilää bàpɛ akà Abàlam anà akà ngyääl ande, bàtɛn anki naa: « anà akà akyee ande » asànaa ya iler un'kàbɔ, wɛɛ ntɔn mbuur mwɛy mpɛl unsà itoo a Abàlam, ikaswaŋà naa Klistɔ.
Abun, le an'kyän amɛ: kyän a balàbal, Nzam la kàdi kusà. Un'kɔɔn kàsàyà ungö a mbul nkam nà a an'kwem an'tär, ukwe anki mudwa kyän alà. Naa tɛy, ilää aki isàbulà undiir a bunàbun.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa kwal bàfàwal u mbwo a Un'kɔɔn, abun ifàkal anki naa u mbwo a ilää. Wɛɛ kyekà ilää aki Nzam kya kàpɛ akà Abàlam unsà kab a ngway ande.
Apanà, mfun a un'kɔɔn nkye? Wa kàyi ntɔn muswaŋ ube a baar, tii kunà usàyà ikyee a Abàlam awà bàpɛ ilää. Ilää aki akyeey bàkyään u mbwo a mfurboo mwɛy.
Kyekà, nkalsà awà kà wà ntɔn mbuur mwɛy mpɛl anki, wɛɛ Nzam wà mwɛy.
Isin a Un'kɔɔn
Abun, nkye Un'kɔɔn afàmbäär ilää a Nzam? Ŋaa, akà ikikye! Wɛɛ yàlàkal naa Un'kɔɔn we anà ikɔ̈b apà mɔ̈ɔ̈, abun balàbal sye làlàfà u mbwo a wa.
Wɛɛ Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yàkyàsà mɛɛn manswà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b man'be. Kyakin, unsà làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ, ilää waa isàkwo akà aŋàlàkwikilà.
Kusà a ngyeel a làkwikilà, bi kàkäl atsüüŋ a un'kɔɔn, tii umpal làlàmɛnà làkwikilà alà.
Kyakin, un'kɔɔn kàkäl un'leer abi tii u ngyeel a Klistɔ, ntɔn bi ikäl bàbalàbal u mbwo a làkwikilà.
Wɛɛ, ungö a ngyeel a làkwikilà, bi ifàkal anki kà an'kɔɔ a un'leer awà.
Ntɔn bɛ banswà, bɛ làbà baan a Nzam u mbwo a làkwikilà amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Inye, bɛ banswà abà làwɛl ndüümà amu Klistɔ, bɛ làkyàbwaar Klistɔ.
Kyakin, Un'yudà itàkal Un'gɛlɛki ufàkal anki. Un'tsüüŋ itàkal un'nsaay ufàkal anki. Baal itàkal un'kaar ufàkal anki. Ntɔn bɛ banswà làbà mwɛy amu Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Kya isàkal naa bɛ làbà baar a Klistɔ, bɛ làbà itoo a Abàlam anà aŋakwal unsà ilää.
